Dual-agent PCA - independent axes per agent

Each pane is its agent's OWN PCA and has its own orbit camera (drag; scroll zooms). "sync cameras" mirrors your drags; "align B to A" rotates B's constellation onto A's frame. "2D" locks both panes to the flat PC1-PC2 plane.
